description: Foundational document establishing HVT project goals, high-level scope (Atlanta/Dallas/Pittsburgh locations), key stakeholders (FAA, Insurers, Investors), and initial success criteria. This authorizes the planning phase and defines the strategic boundaries before detailed operational work begins.
document_template_primary: PMI Project Charter Template / Standard Venture Initiation Document
steps_to_create: Define project vision based on SMART criteria from plan summary
Identify key stakeholders (FAA, Investors, Insurers)
Draft high-level scope and constraints (CAPEX limits, regulatory gates)
Secure initial sign-off from executive sponsor/investors

description: High-level framework for navigating FAA Part 107 licensing, airspace waivers (LAANC), and airworthiness certification requirements. Defines the compliance pathway to ensure legal flight envelopes without operational shutdowns.
steps_to_create: Map current FAA regulations against proposed drone operations (Part 107 Subpart E)
Define waiver application strategy for each location (Atlanta vs DFW vs Pittsburgh)
Establish compliance reporting and audit protocols
Align with insurance requirements for liability coverage

description: Strategic plan for warehouse acquisition, HVAC safety modifications, and ballistic netting installation. Ensures physical locations meet year-round operational requirements and safety buffer standards.
steps_to_create: Evaluate potential warehouse sites against zoning and airspace constraints
Define HVAC modification requirements for air quality standards
Specify ballistic netting and safety zone specifications
Develop CAPEX budget allocation for physical modifications

description: Framework governing the selection and deployment of drone hardware (sensors, LiDAR), telemetry systems, and data protection protocols. Balances user experience quality with cybersecurity risks and maintenance costs.
document_template_primary: IoT Security Architecture Framework / Hardware Deployment Plan
steps_to_create: Define hardware specifications for collision sensors and tracking telemetry
Establish cybersecurity standards (AES-256 encryption) for data streams
Outline penetration testing requirements prior to launch
Plan for supply chain resilience regarding custom sensor procurement

description: Strategic approach to marketing the HVT concept as 'tactical sport' while mitigating community backlash regarding military themes. Includes dual-branding guidelines and partnership frameworks for veterans groups.
steps_to_create: Develop dual-branding messaging (tactical sport vs combat simulation)
Draft community engagement plan including town halls and grievance channels
Define partnership criteria for veterans groups to ensure legitimacy without political risk
Create media relations protocols for public perception management

document_name: Revenue Scalability & Franchise Business Model Framework
description: High-level framework outlining growth pathways beyond ticket sales. Includes corporate team-building package structures and franchise licensing models for regional expansion.
document_template_primary: Business Model Canvas / Revenue Strategy Framework
steps_to_create: Define pricing tiers and corporate package structures
Establish franchise eligibility criteria and IP licensing terms
Project revenue streams for Year 1 vs. Long-term scalability
Identify key performance indicators (KPIs) for retention and expansion

document_name: Initial High-Level Budget & CAPEX Allocation Plan
description: High-level financial framework outlining the $500,000 per location CAPEX requirements. Includes contingency funds for insurance premiums and regulatory delays.
steps_to_create: Estimate costs for warehouse fit-out, HVAC, and netting per location
Allocate budget for hardware acquisition ($50k contingency for insurance premiums)
Define cash flow runway requirements (6-month operating reserve)
Establish financial reporting cadence for investors

description: High-level plan detailing communication strategies with key stakeholders including FAA, Insurers, Community Residents, and Corporate Clients.
steps_to_create: Identify primary and secondary stakeholders from SWOT analysis
Define communication channels for regulatory reporting vs community town halls
Draft escalation paths for conflict resolution with regulators or neighbors

description: Initial register of top risks (Regulatory, Safety, Financial) with high-level mitigation strategies. Serves as a living document for risk management during planning.
steps_to_create: List identified risks from SWOT and Expert Review documents
Assign probability and impact scores to each risk
Define mitigation owners for high-priority risks (e.g., Insurance Broker for Liability)
